text: My daily routine is simple but well organized. I usually wake up at seven o'clock and start my morning with a glass of water and a healthy breakfast. After that, I get ready and begin work at nine. I work until five in the afternoon, with a short lunch break around noon. In the evening, I like to exercise for about thirty minutes, either running or cycling. Then I cook dinner and relax by reading or watching a film. I try to go to bed before eleven. This consistency helps me stay healthy, focused, and ready for each new day.
